Description: This service is related to accessibility features that involve motion tracking, such as Head Pointer, which allows users to control the cursor with head movements.
Impact of Disabling: Disabling this will prevent the use of accessibility features that rely on tracking user motion.

Description: This daemon manages accessibility assets, which are resources used by various accessibility features to enhance user interaction with the system.
Impact of Disabling: Disabling it may cause accessibility features to function incorrectly or not at all, as they may not be able to load necessary resources.

Description: This is a core daemon for Universal Access, which provides accessibility features for users with disabilities.
Impact of Disabling: Disabling this will likely break most accessibility features on the system, such as VoiceOver, Zoom, and Switch Control.
